records.title: Expansion of Aviation Infrastructure
details: (c): Domestic air cargo facilities are planned at Noida (Jewar), Navi Mumbai, Dholera, Silchar, Hirasar, Jharsuguda, Itanagar (Hollongi) and Kanpur airports.

records.title: Elevated Corridor between RG Square and IG Square
details:
Consultancy for preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR)
of the proposed flyover connecting Indira Gandhi Square and Rajiv
Gandhi Square was awarded through PWD, Union Territory (UT) of
Puducherry in July, 2022 on the request of then Hon’ble Chief Minister
of Puducherry. Draft DPR has been submitted by the consultant.
The stretch is presently under maintenance by National Highways
Authority of India (NHAI). NHAI has conducted a study which has
recommended construction of a bypass from Kalapettai on NH 332A
(East Costal Road) crossing this stretch at km 13/300 of old NH 66
(New NH-32) and joining at km 24/800 of Old NH 45A (NH 332),
bypassing the stretch connecting Indira Gandhi Square and Rajiv
Gandhi Square on old NH 66 for through traffic from Mamallapuram
towards Villupuram, Cuddalore & other places.
